iconicAnchor.label: Large-format transit and outdoor advertising
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Transit-scale advertising shows how extreme type size, image reduction, short messages, silhouette, contrast, and repeated exposure serve viewers who are moving past the work.

sources.title: Rails to Sales on the New York City Subway
supports: Large public advertising depended on concise persuasive messages, strong image-type relationships, standardized display formats, and repeated exposure in transit space.

sources.title: The Modern Poster
supports: Modern large-format graphics use simplification, contrast, scale, flat shape, and condensed text to make an immediate public impression.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches silhouette, monument scale, polychrome, advertising pace, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/billboard-bold/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
